page.overview:
What is Baravar Cloakshadow?

Baravar Cloakshadow (), known as the Sly One, was the neutral good gnome deity of illusion and deception. His dogma primarily concerned the protection of the gnome race through the art of illusion.

Baravar was a crafty, vengeful power that was unforgiving of any who threaten his charges. He was known to feels no compunctions about acting against those that has opposed him. Unlike Garl Glittergold's love of a good practical joke, Baravar's preferred jests and tricks that cause no small discomfort to the victims. He was also a thief and enjoyed using illusions to confuse creatures before robbing them, as he stole mostly out of sheer boredom.

The Sly One dispatched avatars to defend gnomes oppressed by humanoids; he often sent one to harass goblinkin. "Do unto them before they have a chance to do unto you" was a philosophy he often acted upon.

Baravar was closely allied with the other non-evil members of the gnome pantheon. His other allies were Azuth, Brandobaris, Clangeddin Silverbeard, Erevan Ilesere, Mystra, Sehanine Moonbow, Tymora, and Vergadain. His chief enemies were the deities of the goblin and kobold races. Other foes were Cyric (for killing his one-time ally, Leira), Abbathor, Mask, and Urdlen.
